typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CONTACT_ID as string,
		TRAN_ID as string,
		SHIP_DATE as string,
		ERROR as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_ship_conf_*']) ~> source1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> addADFId
ConditionalSplit1@toUpsert derive(Status_TS__c = coalesce(toString(toDate(SHIP_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd')), SHIP_DATE),
		Status__c = case(isNull(SHIP_DATE)&&not(isNull(ERROR)), 'Error', not(isNull(SHIP_DATE)), 'Shipped')) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn2 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Contact__c = CONTACT_ID,
		Id = TRAN_ID,
		Status_TS__c,
		Status__c,
		Error_Message__c = ERROR
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
addADFId split(isNull(CONTACT_ID)||isNull(TRAN_ID) || (isNull(SHIP_DATE) && isNull(ERROR)),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(toReject, toUpsert)
ConditionalSplit1@toReject derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF:Field contain NULL value: ', iif(isNull(CONTACT_ID), 'CONTACT_ID ', ''), iif(isNull(TRAN_ID), 'TRAN_ID ', ''), iif((isNull(SHIP_DATE) && isNull(ERROR)), 'SHIP_DATE & ERROR', ''))) ~> rejectReason
rejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_ship_conf_Fulfillment_Orders__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toUpsert
addADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_ship_conf_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedRaw
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_ship_conf_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> RejectOutput
